tasks.label: CMake: Configure
args: if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang++ -DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER="$(command -v gfortran)" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; else cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER=gfortran -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; fi

tasks.label: CMake: Reconfigure (fresh)
args: rm -f build/CMakeCache.txt && if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang++ -DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER="$(command -v gfortran)" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; else cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER=gfortran -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; fi
